{{Infobox auto}}

'''Cooked porkchop''' is cooked meat. Like all meat in Matcha Flavoured, it has no [[intrinsic]]: it heals {{Value|Cooked Porkchop|heals}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_pork.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw porkchop cooks in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Cooked Porkchop|cook_time}}. The vanilla recipes are replaced, and in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] it becomes [[Charred Meat|charred meat]] instead.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Cooked Porkchop|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Cooked Porkchop|heals}}.

Cooked porkchops are used in [[lumpia]] and [[pupusa]]s and can top a [[Pizza|meat pizza]]. Raw porkchops go into [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]]. Cooked porkchops found in chests use the pack's loot table, with the same healing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/cooked_porkchop.json}}</ref>

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Raw Porkchop ==
{{Vanilla|Raw Porkchop}}
'''Raw Porkchop''' is dropped by animals as in vanilla. It keeps its vanilla food values and doesn't heal.
{{Uses|Raw Porkchop}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer made meat plain so that players have less reason to build animal farms: "since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=And since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses.}}</ref>
